review.title: Review · cortex-web #479
review.prTitle: Paginate the invoice list in the API
author: HM
Hugo Martin
review.c1: `q.page` comes from the query string. With `?page=abc`, `Math.max` returns `NaN` and Prisma gets `skip: NaN`: the query fails with a 500.
review.c2: This sort needs an index on `(orgId, createdAt, id)`. Without it the query scans the whole table: 1.4 s measured on the production copy.
review.c3: Add a case with two invoices created in the same second: that is exactly what the second sort key fixes.

pr.title: Fix invoice pagination
pr.desc:
## Problem
Page 2 of the invoices showed the same rows as page 1: the offset started at 0 while the API counts pages from 1.

## Changes
- Offset computed from page 1 in listInvoices
- Stable sort by id as a second key
- 3 regression tests

## Checks
- pnpm test billing: 48 passed
